observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 5 source files — exposed in version control and git history.
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback; if missing, fail immediately. Remove all hardcoded password defaults. Rotate the exposed credential. Migrate to secrets manager for production.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess (even non-zero exit). Does not verify actual relay success.
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay execution success.

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST=172.16.12.2 and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded with silent fallback — masks misconfiguration in production deployments.
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production mode; require explicit opt-in for test mode.

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True hardcoded — no real assertion that task produces no side effects.
observations.recommendation: Assert no git changes (git status --porcelain), no file writes outside test/tmp directories, no network calls outside Redis.

observations.description: STARTED state not explicitly checked in e2e test — only RECEIVED, ACCEPTED (tautological), COMPLETED are verified.
observations.recommendation: Add explicit STARTED state check: verify task:<task_id> exists with state='STARTED' before COMPLETED.
